eligibility_rationale: Flower colour morphs are exposed to herbivory/florivory and maternal fitness is measured across populations/years; pollinator response to simulated florivory is experimental. Glaphyrid beetles provide pollination service to red flowers while also producing petal scratch damage, so one fixed antagonist sign cannot be assigned.

Flower size, herkogamy and mating system covary across the geographic transition while pollen limitation, fruit set and Mompha floral parasitism are measured at different spatial subsets. This is the same Camissoniopsis programme already represented by SCHPRISMA-000287 and cannot be promoted to one new shared-coordinate H1 axis.
